outputs.explanation: Spatial transcriptomics cluster image, not a quantitative summary plot.
H&E histology images with manual region annotations; not a quantitative plot.
H&E image and spatial gene expression heat maps; these are spatial expression visualizations (heatmap-like), not bar/scatter plots of averaged data requiring individual point overlay.
GSEA enrichment plots are line plots, which are exempt from requiring individual data points.

Bar chart shows single computed log2 fold-change values per gene from differential expression analysis (with associated p-values), not an average of multiple replicate measurements, so individual data points are not applicable here.
